---
title: "Try This Instead..."
---

Many phrasings in medicine are not patient-centered.
Try to remember that patients and their loved ones read medical documentation.
Take a step back--how would you feel if you read a note you wrote if it was written about you?

Some articles to consider:

- Caton JB, Vanka A, Dougherty R. Things We Do for No Reason™: Routine use of "denies" and other stigmatizing language in medical documentation. *J Hosp Med*. 2025;20(6):623-627. doi: [10.1002/jhm.13527](https://doi.org/10.1002/jhm.13527)

- Cox C, Fritz Z. Presenting complaint: use of language that disempowers patients. *BMJ*. 2022;377:e066720. Published 2022 Apr 27. doi: [10.1136/bmj-2021-066720](https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj-2021-066720)

- Sykes DB, Nichols DN. There Is No Denying It, Our Medical Language Needs an Update. *J Grad Med Educ*. 2015;7(1):137-138. doi: [10.4300/JGME-D-14-00332.1](https://doi.org/10.4300/JGME-D-14-00332.1)

- Monk R, Whitehouse AJO, Waddington H. The use of language in autism research. *Trends Neurosci*. 2022;45(11):791-793. doi: [10.1016/j.tins.2022.08.009](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.tins.2022.08.009)


- Dickinson JK, Guzman SJ, Maryniuk MD, et al. The Use of Language in Diabetes Care and Education. *Diabetes Care*. 2017;40(12):1790-1799. doi: [10.2337/dci17-0041](https://doi.org/10.2337/dci17-0041)


Language and Style Guides:

- [Inclusive Language Guide | American Psychological Association](https://www.apa.org/about/apa/equity-diversity-inclusion/language-guide.pdf)

- [Disability Language Style Guide | National Center on Disability and Journalism](https://ncdj.org/style-guide/)

- [Advancing Health Equity: A Guide to Language, Narrative and Concepts | American Medical Association and AAMC Center for Health Justice](https://www.ama-assn.org/system/files/ama-aamc-equity-guide.pdf)

- [NIH Style Guide](https://www.nih.gov/nih-style-guide)

- [Preferred Terms for Select Population Groups & Communities | CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/healthcommunication/Preferred_Terms.html)

- [When It Comes to Reducing Alcohol-Related Stigma, Words Matter | NIAAA](https://www.niaaa.nih.gov/alcohols-effects-health/reducing-alcohol-related-stigma)

- [Words Matter - Terms to Use and Avoid When Talking About Addiction | NIDA](https://nida.nih.gov/nidamed-medical-health-professionals/health-professions-education/words-matter-terms-to-use-avoid-when-talking-about-addiction)

- [Words Matter (Suicide Language Guide)](https://www.camh.ca/-/media/files/words-matter-suicide-language-guide.pdf)

- [Inclusive Language for Reporting Demographic and Clinical Characteristics | JAMA Network](https://jamanetwork.com/pages/inclusive-language)

- [GLAAD Media Reference Guide](https://glaad.org/reference)
